thread:
alex: FYI I just opened a PR that updates the REST client header handling for tool calls — needs review before the release freeze in ~2h. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8421

marta: linking it here — quick summary?

samir: tl;dr: header forwarding fix + small change to streaming chunking behavior. Should be non-breaking for most callers but touches the client API surface (optional param renaming).

alex: exact diff is mostly this helper change:```js
// old
client.callTool({ tool, input, headers: ctx.headers })
// new
client.callTool({ tool, input, forwardHeaders: ctx.headers })
```

jen: Oof param rename. We should add a compatibility shim if possible. Otherwise add a clear changelog + migration note.

alex: added a compat shim in the PR that accepts `headers` and maps to `forwardHeaders` but flagged it with a TODO to remove in 2 releases. Also included unit tests.

nils: CI is red on one flaky integration test (streaming-chunking-test). Could be a test harness timing issue, not the change. @ci-bot can you paste the failing log?

ci-bot: build #2082 failed
-- failing test: streaming-chunking-test
-- last logs:
  "Expected 3 chunks but got 2"
  command: make test-integration STREAMING=true

samir: I can repro locally, looks like a race in the test. Trying a quick patch to increase timeout. If tests pass I'll push a fix to the PR.

marta: Assuming tests green, who's able to LGTM? We need an approver from SDK owners (cc @jen and @nils).

jen: Will look in ~30m, please mark with the `sdk-review` label.

alex: done — label added. Also left a note in the PR description about the migration: "headers -> forwardHeaders; shim will remain for 2 releases"

nils: if samir's timeout patch fixes CI, I'm happy to approve after a quick glance. If not, we might hold until after the freeze.

samir: pushed the test timeout tweak, rerunning CI. Fingers crossed.

alex: thanks. If anyone sees regressions in the client tests please call it out — we should avoid any runtime breakage for downstream teams.

jen: reading the diff now. Quick question: did you update the example in the docs/snippets?

alex: yes updated snippets in docs/sdk/rest.md and added a small migration note under docs/migration.md

jen: cool, will post LGTM if CI passes and examples look good. :thumbsup:

marta: great — tagging the release manager in case the freeze timeline shifts.

alex: update: CI passed on rerun, streaming-chunking-test happy. Re-run artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference/status/2082

nils: reviewed the code; shim looks fine. LGTM from me, please squash and merge when the queue is clear.

jen: LGTM as well, left one tiny nit about comment wording.

alex: merging now, thanks everyone :rocket:
